item.title: VIRI’s Holiday Gift Guide for the Fitness Girl in Your Life
item.dc:creator: Margaret Cole
item.description: Ten gift ideas for the runner, the gym girly and the 10,000-steps-a-day queen in your life.
item.content:encoded:
Premature? Perhaps. But before you know it, the holiday season will be upon us, and if you like to get ahead of the game like I do, now is the time to start thinking about gifts: for the people you love, and for yourself. Here is VIRI’s guide to the perfect gift for the fitness-focused friend, family member or significant other in your life.

In this guide

  1. For the runner girly4 ideas
  2. For the gym girly3 ideas
  3. For the 10,000-steps-a-day queen3 ideas

1. For the runner girly

When I started long-distance running, I thought I’d picked the cheapest sport there was. To an outsider, all you need is a good pair of shoes. I quickly learned that wasn’t the case: the expenses pile up fast. If you want to make your runner girly’s year, here are a few things they’d probably love.

01

Electrolyte powder

Liquid I.V. works great, but there are plenty of cuter, more flavorful options, like LMNT, Nuun, Ultima and Skratch.

02

Running gels

This one is a little tricky, because most runners have a favorite, but the two most popular brands are Honey Stinger and GU. If you can sneak a peek at their current stash or casually bring it up in conversation, take note and buy them a 5- or 10-pack. Gels get expensive and run out faster than you’d expect, which might make this the most underrated gift on the list.

03

A running belt

Chances are they already have one, but a new one in their favorite color makes every run a little more fun.

04

Their favorite form of caffeine

Coffee pods, beans, ground coffee, energy drinks or energy powder: everyone has their fix. For coffee beans, ground coffee, matcha and cold brew, try Chamberlain Coffee. For energy drinks and powder, Bloom is really popular right now (and delicious). I’ve also been loving UPDATE, co-founded by Kim Kardashian.

2. For the gym girly

For the friend whose favorite room is the weight room.

01

Creatine and pre-workout

Any serious gym girly loves her supplements. Get them a fun flavor to try before their next session.

02

A cute shaker bottle

The perfect partner for whatever supplement you choose. Most shaker bottles are designed for practicality rather than looks, so find a cute one to make their supplements (and water) more fun. Etsy is a great place to look.

03

A new workout set

Every gym girly loves a matching set. Whenever I wear a cute one, my workout is instantly elevated. If you don’t know their colors or size, a gift card to their favorite activewear brand works too: think Lululemon, Vuori, Athleta, LSKD, Oner Active or Athluna.

3. For the 10,000-steps-a-day queen

For the friend who never skips her morning walk.

01

Ankle or wrist weights

Amazon and Target have great options for relatively cheap. A pair in their favorite color instantly elevates a morning walk.

02

Eye patches

Every aesthetic morning routine includes a good set of eye patches, and Sephora has plenty to choose from. Lately I’ve been loving the Topicals Faded Under Eye Brightening & Clearing Eye Masks and the Yepoda Depuff Eyespresso caffeine eye patches. The Yepoda patches come 60 to a single jar for $32, so they’re much less wasteful than the usual individually wrapped pairs.

03

A hair mask

A long morning walk is the perfect time to wear a hair mask. Wash it out in the shower when you get home, and enjoy silky hair for the rest of the day.

The quick list

The runner girly

  • Electrolyte powder
  • Running gels
  • A running belt
  • Their favorite caffeine

The gym girly

  • Creatine and pre-workout
  • A cute shaker bottle
  • A new workout set

The steps queen

  • Ankle or wrist weights
  • Eye patches
  • A hair mask

Happy (early) gifting!
